tickets.title: US002: Registration Mode Seat Validation
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want the system to block me from adding full classes to my current semester schedule in "Registration Mode", so that I do not accidentally plan for a class I cannot take.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: The system checks the live registration database for current semester capacity.
2. Pass/Fail: An error message is displayed, and the action is blocked if a student tries to drag a "Full" class into their active semester schedule.
